uncertain_terms.note: Arabic-letter spelling of the manufacturer name 'ABB'.
Source uses the Arabic letter م (M); rendered 'I3-M6'.
Trailing '00' in the source is unexplained; kept verbatim. It may be a corrupted rendering of 'etc.'.
Source splits the word; rendered 'Switzerland'. 'مللي أمبير' rendered 'mA'. The English phrase 'individual oils connection circuit' is garbled in the source and was kept verbatim.
Source word literally means 'session'; it appears to be a corrupted label and was rendered literally as 'Session'.
Most of the body survives only as fragments (numbers, single words, ':' placeholders); translated faithfully as printed.
